principles: Model pre-contest material using native stage/labels where supported; do not force one IMO-style shortlist numbering system.
Separate candidate appearance identity, historical selection outcome, and mathematical Version fidelity.
A selected unchanged candidate may share a Version with a final only when same-Version fidelity is actually established.
A selected revised candidate uses candidate-version revised-into final-version when strict Version difference is established.
Do not infer public shortlist-only status solely from absence of a P3B final relation.
publicProjection: Eligible BW-CAND appearances are public shortlist-only only after historical selection outcome is not-selected and the Version graph has no BW-final sharing/revised path.
